span.p: Organic traffic is flat / low — where do we start?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fix crawlability FIRST
· robots.txt allows key paths
· XML sitemaps = canonical/indexable/200 only
· log-file analysis: what Googlebot actually crawls
· close facet/parameter/soft-404 crawl leaks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fix rendering
· CSR → SSR / SSG / prerender
· verify rendered DOM in URL Inspection
· dynamic rendering is DEPRECATED, not a target

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Is it INDEXED — and only what should be?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fix indexation
· canonical: one per page
· noindex to REMOVE — not robots-disallow
· hreflang for international
· index/canonicalize/noindex/block per page class

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Can engines UNDERSTAND it — entities, structure, intent?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Strengthen understanding
· flat hub-and-spoke IA + internal linking
· topical-authority / entity map
· JSON-LD structured data for eligible types
· intent coverage, not keyword strings

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compete on quality signals
· E-E-A-T + helpful-content posture
· topical authority / content depth vs SERP
· Core Web Vitals INP/LCP/CLS as a tiebreaker
· links/authority — earned, not this team's build
